_comment: Density contraction standoff demo (drill mode): an Infantry regiment at (520, 340) is selected at tick 10, presses T twice (NORMAL to TIGHT at tick 30, TIGHT to LOOSE at tick 70) and Shift+T at tick 140 (LOOSE back to TIGHT). During the contraction every body converges on a re-centred slot at once; the in-transit same-unit standoff keeps converging neighbours at body clearance instead of letting them compress into each other. Sampled to tick 540 so the contracted block is settled at the last sample.

path_crossing.reason: A density shift re-centres every slot at once, so files converge across each other by design; the same clip on the pre-fix code crosses paths just as much (0.475) while stacking bodies to 0.16 wu, and the standoff only keeps the converging bodies apart.
